rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Miniature.
Registration name: TINtail
Exhibition name: Cottontail
rows.Origin:
Bred by Leslie E. (Gene) Strawn (United States, 1983).
Introduced in United States by Tiny Petals Miniature Rose Nursery Historic Archive in 1983 as 'Cottontail'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Mild fragrance. 30 to 36 petals. Average diameter 1.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in large clusters, reflexed, rounded bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, well-branched. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Hardy. very vigorous.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 5,436 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: Tiny Petals Nursery says Cottontail was introduced on February 1, 1983. Correct parentage is: 'Pink Petticoat' x Unknown.
